title: Benchmarking Classification Tasks of Chest X-ray AI Across Multinational Public and Private Datasets: a retrospective diagnostic accuracy study
abstract: arXiv:2505.16027v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) AI models are increasingly proposed for triage, screening, and rule-out, where the operating point is fixed to miss few abnormalities. Most evaluations instead report threshold-free discrimination on a few public benchmarks, leaving clinically usable performance and generalisability to unseen institutional cohorts poorly characterised. We retrospectively evaluated 10 published CXR classification models on 12 datasets from six countries: seven public benchmarks and five institutional cohorts from China, Japan, and Germany. Models spanned convolutional networks, vision-language models, a question-answering foundation model, and a repurposed encoder. Only image-level classification was assessed; segmentation, detection, and report generation were out of scope. Source labels were harmonised to a common vocabulary. translated_title: 跨多国公开与私有数据集的胸部X光AI分类任务基准测试：一项回顾性诊断准确性研究
translated_abstract: 胸部X光（CXR）AI模型越来越多地被提出用于分诊、筛查和排除诊断，其工作点被固定以尽量减少漏诊异常。然而，大多数评估仅报告在少数公开基准数据集上无需阈值设定的判别性能，导致临床上可用的性能以及对未见过的机构队列的泛化能力未能得到充分表征。我们回顾性评估了10个已发表的CXR分类模型在来自六个国家的12个数据集上的表现，包括七个公开基准数据集和来自中国、日本和德国的五个机构队列。这些模型涵盖卷积神经网络、视觉-语言模型、问答基础模型和一个改造过的编码器。仅评估了图像级分类任务；分割、检测和报告生成不在评估范围内。原始标签被统一为通用词汇表。主要结局指标为95%灵敏度下的特异度；95%灵敏度下的阳性预测值（PPV）和AUROC为次要结局指标。
tldr: 该研究以95%灵敏度下的特异度为主要指标，在来自六个国家的12个公开与机构数据集上回顾性评估了10个已发表的胸部X光AI分类模型，系统表征了其临床可用性能与跨机构泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study retrospectively benchmarked 10 published chest X-ray AI classification models across 12 public and institutional datasets from six countries, using specificity at 95% sensitivity as the primary metric to characterize clinically usable performance and cross-institutional generalisability.
